NGT Orders Action Against 53 Delhi Hotels and Guest Houses

The National Green Tribunal (NGT) has ordered officials to take action against 53 hotels and guest houses in Delhi. Sub-Divisional Magistrates (SDMs) are to submit reports on the matter. The NGT's directive has reportedly caused consternation among officials.
